$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Cart

band.rule: Takes the band of the service that uses it; commitment state inside it is band 2.

job: Review what was chosen, where it goes and what it costs, then move to payment.
useFor: The step between choosing items and paying for them.
notFor: A single-item purchase with its own flow, or a booking.

forbidden: A back stack that loses the cart.

allowed: One row per chosen item with its quantity control and its states: default, removing, unavailable, cannot be delivered, low availability (live data only).
forbidden: Items the person did not add.
A hold timer when nothing is held.

allowed: Select Location / widget; with no address, a title and one CTA that adds one.
forbidden: A paid delivery option selected in advance.
A disabled checkout as the only sign that an address is missing.

allowed: One promotional block for an optional extra.
SectionTitle with cards-slider (row) and one MediaCard type.
TabBar action bar · Actions: the total and one Primary.
forbidden: A disabled Primary that hides validation.
A fee that first appears on the payment page.

rules: The total shown here is the total paid: delivery, taxes and fees included (M4).
Removing an item uses the destructive AddToCartCTA and can be undone.
Availability messages come from live data only (M4).
One Primary that names the outcome, always enabled; on tap it says what is missing (M10).
Cross-sell and related rows sit below the items and the delivery choice.

allocation.App level: L3 · a transaction step. Opened from the cart bar, never from Today.
allocation.Withheld: The whole page is P0 for Dependents and Organised groups.
allocation.Empty: EmptyState, full page, replaces spaces 1 to 4 and offers a way back to the service.

allocation.Inherits: Marketplace: DNA Supportive · band 6 · interrupts for offers are T3 · suppressed in sacred windows.

notes: items: Less Available without live stock, or on Udhiya or Hady.
cross-sell: Any upsell when the cart holds Udhiya or Hady.
items: Product Item (Default, Remove Product, Off, cann't delever, Less Available) from 🛍️ Market.
example.inTheFlowToday: The main action is disabled when there is no address and when the cart is empty; "only N left" shows without a stated threshold.
